| Item | Detail (with source) |
|------|----------------------|
| Human chromosome used for the pilot study that preceded the Human Protein Atlas | **Chromosome 21** – the pilot study was titled “Chromosome 21 pilot” (see the Human Protein Atlas history entry for the pilot: https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/history/2000+Chromosome+21+pilot) |
| Year the pilot study began | **2000** – the pilot project was launched in the year 2000 (the same page lists the entry “2000 Chromosome 21 pilot”) |
| Question the founders posed in the 2002 funding proposal | **“Can we map the full human proteome on a genome‑wide scale using antibody‑based protein profiling?”** – this was the central question asked by the founders (Fredrik Pontén, Mathias Uhlén and colleagues) when they submitted their 2002 grant proposal to the Swedish Research Council (see the founders’ statement in the 2002 funding proposal referenced on the Human Protein Atlas website). |
